# Interior switch upgrades and wiring

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove the top plate, faceplate, and switch panel to upgrade interior switches with new wiring. [t751]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the top plate over the radio by gently prying it off with a small screwdriver.
2. Take out the top screw and pry back to pop the faceplate off.
3. Unplug all existing connectors located behind the faceplate.
4. Grab both sides of the cup holder area and pull up until it releases.
5. Pull forward on the shift console piece, then pull back carefully to remove it from the shift lever.
6. Remove the two screws holding the switch panel piece on and gently pull it back enough to access wiring.
7. Disconnect the battery before working with electrical connectors.
8. [Partial] Unplug the existing factory switch plug located at the back of the dashboard switch area.
9. Set up the new switch by jumpering specific pins or tapping wires depending on the desired lighting configuration.
10. Tap all wires onto the connector using female crimp ends and wire taps as needed.
11. [Partial] Plug everything in to test functionality before fully reassembling the interior.

_Procedure reported by [t751]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-swap-stock-switches-to-otrattw-switches.5311/>_

## Tools

- Small screwdriver [t751]
- Good crimper [t751]
- Wire stripper [t751]

## Parts

- [Partial] 14-gauge wire: approx 5-6 inches per tab [t751]
- Female connectors, 6x [t751]
- OTRATTW SPST Momentary Switch, e.g., V2D2U66B-00000-000 (V2D2U66B-00000-000) [t751]
- Wire taps, 4x [t751]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a multimeter to test which wires give 12V if you don't have Brown and Red going directly to the switch. [t751]
- Label each female end that goes into the taps so you do not get confused during installation. [t751]
